subject: Trump's mail-in ballot endgame

body:
Trump’s order is the culmination of years of attacks on absentee ballots and vote-by-mail. In the months before the 2020 election, Trump repeatedly spread disinformation and conspiracy theories about the legitimacy of mail-in ballots as he campaigned for reelection. With MAGA angling for total control, Trump wants to end their use forever.
Fuel our work with $35 or more right now to help defend the use of mail-in ballots across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062126_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062126_3&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail .
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs the Attorney General to “ take all necessary action ” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We've got to keep fighting and work to protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062126_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062126_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062126_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062126_3&amount=50]

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure , mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”
Opponents of voting rights have proven they'll go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and make sure that they stay in power. Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can to fight their unending desire for control and protect mail-in voting? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062126_3&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

I’m Dr. Annie Andrews, a pediatrician, a mom of three, and the Democrat running for U.S. Senate to defeat Republican Lindsey Graham in South Carolina.
If we flip this seat, we can end Lindsey Graham’s career and help Democrats retake the Senate, and expand the map for Democrats in future elections.
I know this won’t be easy. But I’ve treated kids who were shot, hospitalized, and failed by broken systems. Nothing about this moment feels optional.
We need an overwhelming surge of grassroots support to prove that we can finally defeat Lindsey Graham. So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a split donation of $50, $30, or even $15 between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign right now so we can hit our end of quarter goals? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
Let me introduce myself.
I’ve spent nearly 20 years serving my community as a pediatrician, treating everything from asthma and violent trauma to the emotional toll of growing up in poverty.
I’ve seen what bad policy does to good families — and I’ve seen kids suffer because people like Lindsey Graham would rather protect their own power than protect children.
In 2022, after 15 years of working in hospitals, I ran for Congress because I knew our kids needed a voice in Washington. I lost — and I told my oldest daughter I wouldn’t run again.
But then Trump’s chaos came back.
And Lindsey Graham? He cheered.
The truth is, I’m scared. And I’m angry. And I’m done waiting.
So I’m stepping up — because our kids, and this country can’t afford another six years of Lindsey Graham.
I’m building a people-powered campaign to flip South Carolina and give kids the voice they deserve. And I need your help. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]

clean_body: Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Sincerely, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House | Paid for by the NRSC. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. |

subject: The lessons my father taught me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alex Kelloff for Colorado
body:
https://alexkelloff.com/ [https://alexkelloff.com/]
Friend,
On Father's Day, I'm thinking about my dad and the values he passed down to me. He taught me something I've carried with me my entire life:
"Do well, so that you can do good."
https://alexkelloff.com/ [https://alexkelloff.com/]
He's lived by those words. For nearly 60 years, he's served at the National Institutes of Health, and at 83 years old, he still goes to work every day.
Growing up, I learned that no job was beneath you. I mowed lawns, shoveled snow, and worked construction. I attended public schools, worked my way through college, and learned the value of showing up and doing my part.
Those experiences gave me a deep appreciation for this place we call home.
I'm grateful for the generations that came before me and for the values they passed on. And I'm hopeful about the future we're building for the generations that come next.
To all the fathers, grandfathers, stepfathers, and mentors who have helped shape our lives, thank you.
Happy Father's Day.
— Alex Kelloff

I ran for office on a simple promise: to listen closely to the people I represent and bring their voices into the work of the legislature. That commitment hasn’t changed. body:
What fathers teach us, what voters decide, and 5 days until Freedom Fest
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**June 21, 2026** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
First, happy Father's Day to all the dads, grandfathers, stepdads, mentors, coaches, and father figures in our community.
This weekend, we published a [collection of stories from our writers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) reflecting on the lessons their fathers taught them. Some talked about work ethic. Some talked about faith. Some talked about resilience. And some simply talked about showing up.
One contributor wrote that the greatest lesson his father taught him was that "love is most meaningful when it is chosen." Another reflected on a WWII veteran father who never missed a game when he wasn't traveling for work. Others remembered fathers who taught them to stand up for themselves, think differently, work harder, and stay present.
The common thread wasn't politics. [It was legacy.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The values we pass on. The example we set. And the responsibility we have to leave things better than we found them. Which is also why I want to encourage you to _**consider[Freedom Fest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as a Father's Day gift this year.**_
In just 5 days, we'll gather in Castle Rock for two days celebrating faith, freedom, family, and the values that built this country. Whether it's the rodeo, the Curtis Grimes concert, Greg Gutfeld, the candidate meet-and-greet, the Family Fun Festival, or the incredible lineup of speakers like Nick Shirley, DOG the Bounty Hunter, and Tina Peters, it's an experience designed for the whole family. And kids 17 and under now receive free Bronze Pass admission with a ticketed adult.
**We're also launching a special initiative this week for veterans, Gold Star families, active-duty military members, and first responders.** Several generous donors have stepped forward to sponsor tickets for those who may not otherwise be able to attend. We'll be selecting a number of recipients (first come, first served) because we want Freedom Fest to honor the people who have sacrificed for our freedoms. 👉 _**[Nominate someone here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
🗳️ As ballots begin arriving in mailboxes across Colorado, many voters are still deciding who deserves their vote. That's why RMV spent the past several months interviewing candidates, covering debates, reviewing records, and asking the questions our readers wanted answered. We've pulled all of that reporting into _**[one comprehensive voter guide](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_ —covering the governor's race, attorney general, secretary of state, treasurer, key legislative contests, and more—to help you make the most informed decision possible before returning your ballot.
If your ballot is still sitting on the kitchen counter, take some time this week to [review the races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) before returning it. Colorado ballots must be returned by 7 p.m. on June 30.
**Finally, Freedom Fest is officially just 5 days away.**
Over the next several days, we'll be sharing more videos from speakers across our social media channels and here on the newsletter so you can get a preview of what's coming. Keep an eye on Facebook, Instagram, X, and YouTube as we roll out interviews, clips, behind-the-scenes content, and speaker highlights.
The countdown is on. We can't wait to celebrate with you.

👉 **[Get your tickets now!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
In truth & liberty,
Team RMV
---
[FREEDOM FEST TICKETS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| | |
---
| | **TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK**
---
**[Colorado rebuilt how it votes twice. Its federal plan never caught up.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold has called the state’s switch to mail-in voting a transformation of democracy. The federal election plan Colorado keeps on file describes an election system mostly built around precinct polling places. Both come from the state.
**[Wolf opponents ask federal officials to revisit Prop 114 after Keshel report challenges 2020 result](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The fight over Colorado wolves has landed in a federal review process. Opponents of wolf reintroduction are asking federal officials to reconsider Colorado’s wolf program after submitting a report that claims Proposition 114 did not actually pass.
**[Lara Logan: Why ordinary people still give her hope](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A few weeks after walking out of a Colorado prison, Tina Peters will take the stage at RMV Freedom Fest. Lara Logan will follow her to the microphone. After decades covering wars, terrorism, government corruption and some of the biggest stories in the world, Logan still talks most about people like Peters.
|
---
**STATE**
**[Colorado is cutting funding for its poorest students. The tool meant to replace it was suspended.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) In Colorado’s smallest school districts, the ones tucked into rural towns, two state programs direct extra money each year to districts based on how many students live in poverty. They are not a lot, but they are specific. They are meant for those kids. And they are going away.

**[ICE detention cases are surging in Colorado. The DOJ keeps losing the legal fight.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Five people filed habeas corpus petitions challenging their Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention in all of Colorado federal court in 2024. One hundred five filed in 2025. Through June 15th of this year, 722 have filed, and the pace has held at more than 150 a month since March.

**[Beverly Aikins on faith, recovery and the next right thing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Hillbilly Elegy made her a character in her son's book. Ten years into recovery, the nurse and grandmother is telling it herself—and bringing it to the RMV Freedom Fest on June 26.

_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[DPS Fires Teacher After Students Report Pressure To Participate In Same Sex Kissing Skits](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Denver Public Schools board members voted unanimously May 20 to dismiss a 50-year-old foreign language teacher following a district investigation and an independent review into student complaints about a class assignment.

**[DU Restructures as Enrollment Falls 19 Percent From Pandemic Peak](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Odifure Udegbe walked the stage Friday to chorus of whoops and hollers as he received his Master’s in Science degree from the University of Denver. Originally from Nigeria, Udegbe said he enrolled at DU to make himself more competitive in a tough job market.
**[New Analysis Examines Why Homelessness Is Concentrated in Mesa County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE BUSINESS TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) As the Grand Junction City Council debated whether to amend city code to strengthen enforcement of the camping ordinance, questions about shelter capacity and the size of the local homeless population took on new importance.
**_[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Temper, temper](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MARK SALLEY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _The Left is having a temper tantrum over America250. The babysitters spent the last 10 to 20 years...letting the children do exactly what they wanted. The children didn’t like mommy’s and daddy’s rules. So the babysitters, rather than enforcing the time-tested rules, let the children break them. And, break the rules they did. They left behind civility, honesty and responsibility._
__
**[An open letter to the 10th Circuit on free speech and the First Amendment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Similar to what Lincoln said of himself — I’m a slow walker but I don’t walk backwards — I often get busy with life and have to shelve writing projects without letting them go. I wrote back in early May about a decision rendered by the 10th Circuit Court of Appeals on legislative immunity._
__
**[Know your judges: New Mesa County appointment highlights Colorado’s selection process](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Per the article linked first below, Gov. Polis back in early May appointed a new judge in the Mesa County Judicial District. Quoting with link intact: “Effective on July 1, 2026, Courtney L. Dinnel will serve as a Mesa County Court Judge. The appointment was made to fill a new judgeship created by SB25-024, which increased the number of judges in certain county courts, including Mesa County’s, by one.”_ __
**_[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[School Board Pays $95K After Censoring Student Tribute to Charlie Kirk](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE CHRISTIAN POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A North Carolina school district has agreed to pay $95,000 in attorneys’ fees and damages after censoring an on-campus student tribute to conservative Christian activist Charlie Kirk.

**[Trump Refuses FISA Extension Without Voter ID and Citizenship Measures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE WESTERN JOURNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) President Donald Trump said Monday that he will not support an extension of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act unless it includes his election integrity measure, the Save America Act.

**[World Cup Visitors Discover Heartland Hospitality and American Traditions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Christopher Columbus made his name over 500 years ago, but a new crop of Europeans is discovering America during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, posting rave reviews of comfort food and rural hospitality on social media.

_**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133757757/629006350/1231236074?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.06.21_VotedNo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmM2YTgzNi1lMjZkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TPbZI9gx3Mm3bvWScqYu2LEcLQJSqNsJwwPkoC2IPB8=&emci=15d09b3c-ce6d-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&emdi=9fc6a836-e26d-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=23483442) | Peter, I voted **NO** on the Republican budget. Families across WA-06 are struggling with the cost of groceries, gas, housing, child care, and health care. **Congress should be focused on making life more affordable for working people.** Instead, Republicans put forward a budget that does nothing to lower costs for families.
* **Nothing to lower gas prices.**
* **Nothing to lower grocery costs.**
* **Nothing to lower health care costs.**
* **Nothing to lower child care costs.**

Iranian state media blamed an "insulting message" from President Trump. | | | | | | Monday, June 22, 2026 ---|--- Good Morning! On this day in 1938, Joe Louis knocked out Germany's Max Schmeling in the first round of their heavyweight title rematch at Yankee Stadium, a 124-second rout watched by 70,000 fans and heard by millions on the radio. ## Cruz, Cornyn Question Iran Deal
U.S. Sens. [Ted Cruz and John Cornyn](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu2zAMRb_G3hhYlGO_Dhq6eEvXjoYi0okKiTIk2U769YUD9AveeEiQOPf-vs0364OXxy8b2dTXkmbhowSulfNc-WVLtvLgXFwK5GzhTXyNM3Y4QDcA4kzWh_fct2TuHf1QLRs1fqHCQfVj-zRXvYzcK7cwfrHWd0U8aBxI214ha2q9OZ91A6JSHeJ4cVovOPTo6KrvV3dt-o7J15Qv9ckfpSW808754lJsg3nWupZG_2xwanA6juPi7uVMce4bnD4nDU7n6D9CYbE15QKVCVze_sKf9BRwKctbgF9r5lLAJXGcpcCJnlgq1LzFFfYVdiuOC_hsBYhtgMgxZSu0RdiEOJdqhbw8GpzabGg9fAi-DGPTd49offjo1--Vvhv8FwAA___g-pyE) of Texas say they're troubled by President Trump's new memorandum of understanding with Iran. Both men backed the military campaign that preceded it. Signed [at Versailles](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu8yAQhJ_G7hzBYoNTUPxNuvztKa01uyRI64uA3N7-yHmFU45GGn3z_VynKyZJ6-0_LuzrO27Tyq8iXCvnqfIbS8b1xrmETShg4cea6jKBAtsp2wFMhEk-U9-SnxWddcteuxE0WN279u7nGK2ejXKjdsRkYdRKGbZs7BADuDb5Y0xZAK0VgDsFYyLYHgINZh7C0PSKKdUtn-qdv0hRPtuT8ylsSyv-XuteGvOvgUsDF9yPA0d1hFxTEG7gEjOugbuUce2IUbon54JJhEtX82PZO6IhYjzH0bLS0dowAFI_OwMjxVGbNnvaX0kkFeuaXt0WTPJFqH8T9_TwGwAA__-Uf4Hu), the [14-point framework](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2urCAUhZ8GOyewVXAKitvYzW1PaRC2uhPACez5e_sT5xVOvbK-rPX93Oabo0h5--8SWn6vx5zxVSMyY5kZ364Wlzcs1R8xeFfxkYnTDBJ0K3ULMAdH8TP3TbCLDFfVoFVmBAVa9abZrUE9-nE06EazKLNqcFIh-mUENFr1DdkTJjWAUhLAXHzXraB78GHolsEPopcYiI9y4R2_k9b4OZ5YLv5ITbQ7872K7p-AScDEO-4U45kJmPYj4XlIwORCokyVi2M6soBpuIIxo2m5PNK9peJy67aCmDBzG5AdxbPXFBvuL4qRqjail1ty9MU3_DdhTwu_AQAA__9Bh4Cu) would provide sanctions relief if Iran complies, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and let Iran sell its oil freely over a 60-day negotiating window. It also envisions a $300 billion reconstruction fund financed by regional partners, not the U.S. Cruz told reporters, "_History demonstrates that giving billions of dollars to theocratic lunatics who want to murder us is an exceptionally bad idea,"_ while still crediting Trump for crippling Iran's military. Cornyn, who hadn't yet read the text last week, called it "a mixed bag at best." Trump defended the agreement, and Vice President JD Vance, who led the negotiations, said Iran gets no U.S. money and gains relief only if it complies fully.
## San Antonio Approves Toyota Incentives
San Antonio's City Council [voted 11-0 Thursday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ywyAQBOCnkTo06EA_KSjSuHPalMwJTjIzCDRwsa23z8TJG6T9it2d_bzaK4YY0vaBOxl-rtkmetRIzFQs0xNrwbRRqS5H77DSVwq8W5AwCjkKAOsxxNPq1ptF-re-JdNPM_Qw9npqb2adlcJ1keBmP6tllnpBiaDRzQPApNtgfsLkCND3EmDqnFIrjBqcH9QyuKHRknzgXDq-0WvSGs98p9K5vLfR3JiP2qj3Bi4NXComTJxTyIWOXLjLZftl8eei4qMKd1TB-cyMgp4HphpyauDSFuOPR4gx1HFqtNx2DPFVxP-7527gOwAA__8vwHve) to offer Toyota a package of tax breaks and utility incentives to land a $2 billion assembly line and 2,000 jobs on the city's South Side. The roughly $185 million package, led by a 10-year property tax abatement, would also fund road improvements, worker training, and utility upgrades, with clawback provisions if Toyota underdelivers. The city pegged the plant's economic impact during construction at $3.2 billion. It's not a done deal: Toyota says it's [still weighing other U.S. sites](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFypTAQRE8jsvmFBhAmULCJMm-6ITWS5n9UKyQXmjXm9lv4Co67q_t1_3lf3ynlVF6_aWcrX8-6Fj5bZhE-VuEvageVFx8t1BwDNf5Xkuwr9migN4C4Rkr5WscuWt_HRXds9fyGGo0e526zceI4vfnZ0_AMwxiNxhnjMqFZBu-X2CV7h_UGUesecX6EYXiiGTHEafBTmNTYc0xSj4ds_I30zFf95OMR6t5lu4l8NDX8UugUuvM8H38byS0qdPcahS7XQFmhu6sUun5S6PRy27cLCAqfgB6kXlUIqDXefb4gp8KQCjQqQEVqSRVSKwIEsRaGyJThYlHousPGjzPlnJqZ1di_dkr5G1B-duunxf8BAAD__8XJi-A). "_We're hopeful if San Antonio is selected, it will be another once-in-a-generation investment_ ," said Toyota Texas president Frank Voss. Bexar County holds a public hearing on June 23 on a separate tax abatement valued at more than $55 million, and Gov. Greg Abbott is weighing a state incentive backed by Southwest ISD.
## Texas Rangers Double Cold-Case Unit
The Texas Department of Public Safety is doubling the size of the [Texas Rangers' cold-case unit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAQB_CnwQ4Do8JuQfE1dvu1V5JZGF0SFAPc6r79RXNvcO1kMvP__b8e9oEhhnX-jwuZekzJrrSXSLVStpUOLBnXmXJxKXqHhb7XUBcLAhQXigNYjyF-bN948xT-LhsyUt9AgpK9bl5GOwkohL6BvsteKQLttVLqNnUKh-HZBHMeEwpASgGgW9d1E6genB-65-AG1gvyoabc1hddkab4SW_KrUtLE82r1q2w7h-DkcG473vrt9Jei-2c3gzGk8RgvEb818NPED9FfMtpzrhwOjZcfeHociqFl4qVmmz8tocYQ1Ga9WJeMMTrcf1bXW8DPwEAAP__ANmAtw), adding a second investigator to each of the agency's six regional companies to work unsolved murders and sexual assaults statewide. The expansion brings the program to 17 Rangers and three support staff, funded by Senate Bill 1, which lawmakers passed and Gov. Greg Abbott signed last year. A new staff lieutenant will also help oversee the state's Sexual Assault Kit Initiative. Created in 2001, the program has [helped solve more than 300 cases](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtuhDAQBuDTmM7IHozZFC7S0G3alMiPgbVkMLInC3v7iFVukG6KeX3_932625jitnzZFQ2dc542PGpCIiwT4WlrsduCpfqcgrcVf7ZI6wQCNBeaA0zBxvSaVBOME-FDNmjkcAMJWqqheRj0rldB2eAkigBOzGHudeddLwRqd2uiuZYJDSClABha33UzaAU-9J3rfc-UwBApl5Ye-H5pTq_8xNL6vDbJPIj2yrpPBiOD8TiOds6nuhhXA4PxKhmM71H-x-F47nYL_GLxy8X3kpdiV259ybXySpawKSbsR0wpVj0wJZbVxvQ-S_8L62ngNwAA___JQIGZ), including over 156 sexual assaults since 2020, and identified a dozen sets of unidentified remains. "_As forensic science and technology continue to advance, so will our ability to make a bigger impact_ ," said Texas Ranger Division chief Scotty Shiver, "_putting more violent criminals behind bars and making Texas communities safer_."

body:

# [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1113?t=1&akid=760%2E3892029%2EFSTvbT)

Peter,
This message is more serious than the ones I usually send, but you deserve an explanation.
At the end of this month, our Senate campaign will close the books on our most important FEC deadline yet. When it’s over, **we are legally required to report what we’ve raised so far in our efforts to flip Florida's Senate seat blue.** That includes the amount of individual donations.
It is absolutely critical that we file a strong report. Here’s why:
The Senate majority hinges on Florida. This is my first full FEC deadline since jumping into the race, so everybody will be watching to see if we have the grassroots support needed to win.
While Ashley Moody relies on her rolodex of special interest donors to win this race, I am counting on you. Grassroots donations are our #1 source of funding. If we can get a huge surge of donations before this deadline, then we can report a number that shows that we are ready to take our fight straight to the U.S. Senate.
